ranked.headline: Learned protein and ligand representations drive binding prediction and peptide design
ranked.summary: Protein language model and DEL-trained representations are now applied across binding-site, paratope, and peptide design tasks in recent reports.

ranked.headline: Statistical methods link genetic variants to molecular traits and disease genes
ranked.summary: OmiGA, GenT and cross-ancestry GWAS extend QTL and association mapping toward gene-level therapeutic targets across diverse populations.

ranked.headline: Read-level inference of sequencing errors, variants, and phase with minimal reference…
ranked.summary: Read-level and reference-light methods now estimate sequencing error, call small and structural variants, and phase chromosomes from unrelated individuals.

ranked.headline: Long-read isoform inference and scalable differential RNA-seq methods advance
ranked.summary: Long-read isoform tools and scalable differential frameworks now span bulk, single-cell, and ChIP-seq data in February 2026 preprints and publications.

ranked.headline: Metagenomic tools now resolve plasmid hosts, CRISPR arrays, and host sex from reads
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend read-level and reference-based analysis of metagenomes and microbial genome atlases.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models are imposing structure on sparse spatial transcriptomic measurements
ranked.summary: Spatial transcriptomics platforms yield sparse or heterogeneous measurements, driving learned models for domain detection, imputation, and deconvolution.

ranked.headline: Multimodal fusion models predict drug interactions and Alzheimer's diagnosis
ranked.summary: Early 2026 reports couple heterogeneous inputs such as structure, text, imaging and clinical scores within single predictive or encoding models.

ranked.headline: Energy budgets and metabolic costs shape neural coding and synaptic precision
ranked.summary: Recent preprints formalise metabolic and energy budgets as explicit constraints on neural representations and synaptic variability.

ranked.headline: Mapping noncoding GWAS variants to target genes, splicing and 3' end regulation
ranked.summary: Multi-layer functional readouts now connect Alzheimer's and bone density GWAS loci to specific regulatory steps in relevant cell types and tissues.

ranked.headline: Sequence language models extended to genomes, enzymes, and microbiome taxonomy features
ranked.summary: Biological sequence models are being tuned for compact genomes, enzyme EC prediction, and microbiome features in recent work.

ranked.headline: Computational profiling of cancer genomes links somatic alterations to functional impact
ranked.summary: Large single-cell, pan-cancer and patient-level sequencing resources now allow mutation-resolved inference of the functional consequences of genomic alteration.

ranked.headline: Sequence and spectral features predict resistance phenotypes in pathogens
ranked.summary: Recent tools map raw reads, spectra and scanned plates directly to resistance calls, with some positioned as cheaper than WGS.

ranked.headline: Computational models of protein energetics guide receptor and channel modulation
ranked.summary: Enhanced-sampling MD, mechanistic kinetic modeling, and ML QSAR now target GPCR and K2P channel systems in parallel.

ranked.headline: Computational models prioritize molecules for TDP-43, P-gp, and ADMET endpoints
ranked.summary: Computational screens are increasingly paired with synthesis and testing, with P-gp inhibitors reaching single-digit micromolar IC50 values in reported work.

ranked.headline: Computational tracking of dynamic cell structures across microscopy frames
ranked.summary: Tracking structures across frames in moving or deforming samples now avoids segmentation or uses deep networks for registration and annotation.

ranked.headline: Models link coupled components to tissue polarity, invasion, and multistability
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a PCP study add host-circuit coupling and resource competition as explicit drivers of multistability and spatial organization.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomes link gene-level evolution to synteny, methylation and gene loss
ranked.summary: Long-read and chromosome-scale assemblies now let comparative analyses attribute gene-level evolutionary change to defined genomic contexts.

ranked.headline: Tools for batch effects, covariate balance and multi-omics statistical integration
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers add R and Python tools that quantify batch effects, allocate samples, and test multi-omics associations.

ranked.headline: Physics-grounded generative models produce all-atom biomolecular MD trajectories
ranked.summary: Five February 2026 items pair learned models with physics-based or ab initio references for molecular dynamics, binding energetics, and population genetics.

ranked.headline: Generative and autoencoder models map cryo-EM and cryo-ET density to structure
ranked.summary: Learned models now convert noisy cryo-EM and cryo-ET data into density representations, atomic coordinates, and completed tilt images.

ranked.headline: Computational methods recover structural and dynamic information from complex data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply statistical physics, latent sequence representations, and coarse-grained simulation to structural questions across distinct data types.

ranked.headline: Faster sequence analysis for placement, graph alignment, and k-mer streaming
ranked.summary: Pangenome-scale alignment sets (390M alignments) and streaming k-mer workloads call for exact methods whose runtime and storage scale better.

ranked.headline: ML models predict CRISPR off-targets, promiscuous enzymes and peptide cyclization

ranked.headline: Sequence-derived methods probe protein structure, function and co-folding limits
ranked.summary: Sequence-based tools now reveal hidden conformations and active-site geometry, while new benchmarks expose epistasis and ligand-input limits.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level Plasmodium genomes from natural infections; in silico SAV virion model
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication extend genome assembly and in silico structural modeling to Leishmania, Plasmodium, and salmonid alphavirus.

ranked.headline: Platforms integrating heterogeneous biochemical and omics data into queryable form
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool address integration of biochemical, bioprocess, and metagenomics data from heterogeneous sources.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking in silico metabolite predictors against human radiolabeled ADME data
ranked.summary: Open-access metabolite predictors are now being benchmarked against human radiolabeled ADME data for small-molecule drugs.

ranked.headline: Assembly-level analysis of LINE-1, HERV LTR and satellite repeat evolution
ranked.summary: Assembly-level pipelines now estimate retrotransposon insertion ages, chimeric RNA recombination, and higher-order repeat architecture across genomes.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of hidden biological state from confounded omics measurements
ranked.summary: Single-sample and bulk omics readouts are being evaluated as indirect proxies for circadian time, cell cycle phase, and EMT progression.

ranked.headline: Computational tools for peptide identification, DIA analysis, and spectral clustering
ranked.summary: Narrow-window DIA and mobility-resolved acquisition are driving algorithms that model peptide and spectral behavior before identification.

ranked.headline: LLM agents ground single-cell annotation and perturbation prediction in data and tools
ranked.summary: Preprints now couple LLM reasoning to raw scRNA-seq data, mass spectrometry workflows and GEO metadata, enabling checkable zero-shot analysis.

ranked.headline: Computational RNA folding and codon design extend structure-aware sequence modeling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair thermodynamic, learned, and cross-linking evidence with RNA structure prediction and coding sequence design.

ranked.headline: Genomic diversity mechanisms and undiscovered phage richness in microbial populations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication quantify how microbial diversification mechanisms and sampling depth shape estimates of unseen diversity.

ranked.headline: Symmetry and physics constraints shaping molecular generation and property prediction
ranked.summary: Recent items embed group symmetry and physical quantities such as the committor directly into molecular generative and predictive models.

ranked.headline: ML tools for microRNA target prediction, artificial miRNA design, and siRNA efficacy
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply transformers and deep learning to isomiR-aware target prediction, engineered miRNA design, and siRNA efficacy scoring.

ranked.headline: Pathology-preserving automated neuroimaging and SEEG analysis under clinical variability
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply deep-learning registration, harmonized datasets, and automated localization to neuroimaging in epilepsy and brain metastases.

ranked.headline: Foundation model pretraining across imaging, MEG, and molecular property prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints examine how pretraining data, tokenization, and multimodal fusion determine transfer in biomedical foundation models.

ranked.headline: Single-cell atlases link aging to stem cell states and lineage tracing in human tissues
ranked.summary: Single-cell profiling now resolves age-associated cell states in human blood, organs, and lineage trees, with a metric predicting AML survival.

ranked.headline: Forecasting Single-Cell Expression Dynamics Faces Baseline and Metric Scrutiny
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether foundation models and deep forecasters truly beat simple baselines for single-cell trajectory and perturbation prediction.
